landing.faqLead: Answers about macOS .icns margins, corner geometry, and client-side processing.

faqItems.q: Why does PrimalCut add 120 px padding around a 1024 × 1024 icon?
faqItems.a: Since macOS Big Sur, native app icons sit inside an optical grid of roughly 824 × 824 within a 1024 canvas. Rendering your icon onto a 1264 × 1264 canvas with 120 px transparent padding keeps its apparent Dock size aligned with system apps.

faqItems.q: Are my PNG images ever uploaded to a server?
faqItems.a: No. Resizing, corner masking, bicubic resampling, and ZIP compression happen completely inside your browser Canvas and JavaScript memory. Once loaded, the page works even offline.

faqItems.q: Why 22.37% corner radius, and can I disable it?
faqItems.a: 22.37% matches Apple's standard macOS app icon corner proportion. If your artwork already includes transparent margins or custom silhouettes, simply toggle off rounded corners and safe padding under Crop & export options.

faqItems.q: What is the difference between ICNS and PNG Set?
faqItems.a: ICNS outputs a single macOS multi-resolution .icns file ready for Xcode, Tauri, Electron, or Finder Get Info. PNG Set packs standard resized PNG files into a ZIP archive for browser extensions, web assets, and design handoff.

faqItems.q: Which browsers and operating systems are supported?
faqItems.a: Any modern desktop browser (Chrome, Safari, Edge, Firefox) on macOS, Windows, or Linux can generate valid .icns and PNG ZIP bundles directly.

faqItems.q: Are there file format or size limits?
faqItems.a: To keep browser memory conversion fast and reliable, source files must be PNG (.png) under 10 MB, ideally 1024 × 1024 px or higher.

vsCompare.metaTitle: PrimalCut vs iconutil CLI & Image2icon — Honest macOS Icon Tool Comparison
vsCompare.metaDescription: Compare PrimalCut, Apple's iconutil command-line tool, and Image2icon across platform support, macOS corner padding, batch automation, and local privacy.
vsCompare.title: PrimalCut vs iconutil CLI & Image2icon
vsCompare.lead: Different workflows call for different tools. Here is an objective breakdown of what each approach handles best and where its boundaries lie.

rows.label: Platform & setup
rows.colA: macOS only; requires Terminal scripts and manual .iconset folder naming
rows.colB: macOS native app install; some export formats require paid unlock
rows.colC: Runs free in any modern browser on macOS, Windows, or Linux with zero setup

rows.label: macOS corners & padding
rows.colA: No automatic corner mask or margin; must be prepared in design files
rows.colB: Rich built-in templates, device frames, and visual previews
rows.colC: One-click toggle for 22.37% macOS corner radius and 120 px safe padding

rows.label: Multi-size PNG bundles
rows.colA: Requires scripting multiple sips resize commands and zip manually
rows.colB: Exports PNG folders and several desktop icon formats
rows.colC: Built-in extension preset and 7-size macOS AppIcon preset packed as ZIP

rows.label: Privacy & data path
rows.colC: Local browser Canvas & memory execution; zero server uploads

rows.label: CI/CD automation
rows.colA: Best in class; embeds cleanly into Makefiles, Xcode, and GitHub Actions
rows.colB: Supports folder drag-and-drop batching for interactive desktop use
rows.colC: Built for fast visual conversions from one to dozens of icons, not headless CI

rows.label: Extra formats (ICO / Finder folders)
rows.colB: Supports direct Finder folder icon replacement, Windows ICO, and templates
rows.colC: Focused cleanly on high-fidelity .icns and standard PNG ZIP sets

vsCompare.whenPrimalCutTitle: When PrimalCut is the right fit

whenPrimalCutItems.body: You are shipping an Electron, Tauri, or web project from Windows or Linux and need a valid macOS .icns icon immediately.

whenPrimalCutItems.bold: Full-bleed square PNGs that look oversized in the Dock
whenPrimalCutItems.body: You have a raw 1024 × 1024 square graphic and want Apple-style 22.37% rounded corners plus 120 px padding without opening Figma.

whenPrimalCutItems.bold: Unreleased app artwork with strict privacy
whenPrimalCutItems.body: You prefer not to upload unannounced product icons to ad-heavy conversion servers; everything stays in your local browser.

vsCompare.whenOtherTitle: When iconutil or Image2icon is better
vsCompare.whenOtherLead: Where the other two tools clearly shine:

whenOtherItems.body: If your team compiles icons from source assets inside CI scripts on macOS runners, Apple's built-in iconutil + sips remains the gold standard.

whenOtherItems.bold: Customizing Finder folders or textured icon frames (choose Image2icon)
whenOtherItems.body: Image2icon is a polished native macOS utility when you want to drag icons directly onto Finder folders or style icons with 3D templates.
